package.description: ChMac is a command-line-interface (CLI) tool for Windows that changes or randomizes MAC addresses of specified network adapters.

en-US.description: ChMac is a command-line-interface (CLI) tool for Windows that changes or randomizes MAC addresses of specified network adapters.
en-US.longDescription: Named after getmac and chmod, ChMac is a command-line-interface (CLI) tool for Windows that changes or randomizes MAC addresses of specified network adapters, e.g. for a client device to reuse public Wi-Fi hotspot that has exceeded usage limit for the day (e.g. hotels, restaurants), or to enhance security
en-US.name: ChMac
